description: This file defines the asynchronous API for TorchScript, including functions `fork` and `wait` for parallel execution and synchronization within TorchScript. It also registers the `wait` function as a built-in.

methods.name: fork
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous task executing a function or module, returning a Future object that can be waited on.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Forces completion of a Future and returns its result.
